relationship_to_existing_review.purpose: Add only two source-review counterexamples not covered by PN1-PN5.

source_review_negative_candidates.observation: VoiceInputPacket validates monotonic_ms only as nonnegative. VoicePacketCortex.accept_input enforces per-turn sequence but does not enforce nondecreasing monotonic_ms. advance_output likewise accepts a monotonic_ms lower than the current output timestamp as long as the playback transition and heard_fraction are otherwise legal.
source_review_negative_candidates.risk: The deterministic trace can contain causal/timing rollback, negative derived latency, or events whose sequence advances while time moves backward. This can corrupt endpoint, barge-in, latency, and causal replay reasoning even though packet sequence appears valid.

source_review_negative_candidates.observation: queue_output accepts any nonnegative sequence without a per-turn uniqueness/contiguity/order check, while the public outputs property returns packets in lexical packet_id order rather than sequence order.
source_review_negative_candidates.risk: Two output chunks may share a sequence or be exposed in a different order from their declared chunk sequence. A physical binder or test consumer that relies on outputs can therefore observe deterministic but semantically wrong chunk ordering unless an external unproven ordering layer exists.

static_scope.reason: Per F2 failure law, these remain source-review negative candidates until exact implementation execution reproduces them or the implementation owner repairs them before execution.
